mmproj._note: Mandatory: without the projector the model sees no image.

launch.name: spec-type
launch.description: Speculative decoding with the MTP drafter shipped in the same repository (mtp-gemma-4-26B-A4B-it.gguf); the install downloads it and the app wires --model-draft.

launch.name: spec-draft-n-max
launch.description: Draft tokens per step; 2 is the card's server setting (the packager suggests trying 1-6 and keeping the fastest per machine).

launch.name: temp
launch.description: Server-side default sampling temperature; greedy decoding for transcription.

launch.name: parallel
launch.description: A single decoding slot; MTP drafting is single-stream.

launch.name: no-warmup
launch.description: Skip the warmup run at model load (faster start, slower first request).

launch.name: jinja
launch.description: Use the chat template from the GGUF metadata: it parses Gemma 4's thought channel, so the request's thinking mode decides whether the model reasons first.

launch.name: reasoning-budget
launch.description: Server default for the thinking budget; the fix request carries the reasoning mode and overrides it.

launch.name: image-min-tokens
launch.description: Visual token budget floor; Gemma 4 supports 70/140/280/560/1120 and the card recommends the top budgets for OCR and small text.

launch.name: ubatch-size
launch.description: Encoder-free vision: the whole image must fit one ubatch; the patches decode into the main model with non-causal attention, and the default 512 aborts the server on the first image decode.

launch.name: ctx-size
launch.description: The split layout is tuned for this window: 16384 spends ~600 MiB more VRAM for nothing (measured b12137). Overrides the platform's 16384.

launch.name: n-gpu-layers
launch.description: Let llama.cpp's --fit split the 14 GB of weights between VRAM and RAM; the platform's 99 aborts the load with an out-of-memory on a 6 GB card. Requires build b12100+ ('auto' parsed as 0 by older atoi).

launch.name: fit-target
launch.description: The fit margin llama.cpp keeps free on the card; 512 is the measured layout for a 6 GB card (bigger margins leave fewer expert layers in VRAM and slow the prefill).

request.name: repeat_penalty
request.description: Penalty for repeating tokens; 1.0 disables it.

request.name: presence_penalty
request.description: Penalty for tokens already present in the prompt; 0 disables it.

request.name: frequency_penalty
request.description: Penalty proportional to token frequency; 0 disables it.

request.name: stream
request.description: Stream tokens as they arrive; false gives the parser one complete response.

request.name: cache_prompt
request.description: Reuse the prompt cache; off keeps every block request independent of the draft's shared KV cache.

request.name: stop
request.description: Stop sequences; the reply ends with the verdict even when the model would keep generating. Only the protocol marker belongs here: an end-of-text token listed as a stop word is matched against the reply itself and cuts the answer to nothing.
